condition_variants.hard_gates: 眺望點合法可達且安全；官方封閉/營運停止時不成立

condition_variants.penalties: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外

variant_name_i18n.zh-TW: 塘湖古道石階與塘湖嶺鞍部展望
variant_name_i18n.en: Tanghu-trail stone steps and ridge-saddle outlook
variant_name_i18n.ja: 塘湖古道の石段と展望

required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 以 V2 契約條件為準（draft/provisional，未校準）
required_conditions_i18n.en: Judged by the V2 contract conditions (draft/provisional, uncalibrated).
required_conditions_i18n.ja: V2契約の条件に従う（draft/provisional、未校正）。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 塘湖古道（阿里山國家風景區官方列名，200 多年歷史、塘湖至福建坪落差近 500m、石階舊路）與鞍部展望（OSM 塘湖聚落 hamlet 節點對位、待現場校準；海拔誠實留空）；清單主題的茶園梯景查無本站可繫結的權威資料源，誠實以古道主體登記；與既有 tw-105 太平雲梯／梅山36彎（4.47km）題材錯位。
boosters_i18n.en: The 200-year-old Tanghu historic trail (officially listed by the Alishan NSA; near-500 m descent from Tanghu to Fujiannan on old stone steps) with its ridge-saddle outlook (OSM hamlet node as proxy, pending field calibration); the list's tea-terrace wording has no source we can bind - honestly registered as the trail itself; disjoint from tw-105 Taiping suspension bridge 4.47 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 塘湖古道（阿里山風景区公式、200年の歴史と石段）（OSMの集落ノードで対位）。太平吊橋とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外
penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
